overall: Atlanta is running warm but stalled as of 11:30 ET, with a running max of 82.4°F recorded at 11:10 ET — earlier than typical for a June afternoon peak. Confidence is moderate — the 88–89°F bucket carries the highest probability in both INTRADAY (32%) and META (26.7%) models, making 88°F the best single-point estimate.
